name: Pork, Broccoli & Honey Stir-Fry
method: Slice the pork into 1cm strips. Mix the cornflour with a tablespoon of water and set aside.
Stir-fry the pork in half the oil over a high heat for 3 to 4 minutes until just cooked, then lift out.
Add the broccoli and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, then add the rest of the oil, garlic and chilli for 2 minutes, then the sliced pepper for another 2 to 3 minutes.
Stir the soy sauce, half the honey and the cornflour mixture into the pan, return the pork and mix well.
Cook the noodles to the packet instructions, drain, toss with the rest of the honey and serve topped with the stir-fry.
